Description

The multi-use, fully air-conditioned function room at Caterham School Sports Centre is an open plan room with a servery and covered external balcony commanding an impressive panoramic view of the school and grounds. It is ideally suited to accommodate almost any activity ranging from children’s parties, small meetings, aerobics classes and martial arts.

If you’re travelling by car, then you’ll be glad to know there is free parking provided by the venue. The free parking at the facility can fill up at peak times and get busy, with weekends being a very popular time, so allow ample time to ensure you secure a space.

The venue is open to the public to come and book on a one-off basis. Their pay as you go system means that you can book now without being a member. This gives you the freedom to make a one-off booking without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

If a one-off booking isn't enough, then why not take advantage of the block booking option at Caterham School Sports Centre? Block bookings are a great way to guarantee a weekly booking. It also takes the hassle out of paying before each session as there is a one-time payment.

The venue has well maintained changing facilities to use when you book, and is situated near Caterham station.
